entries.value: Ridge Vineyards ‘Essence’ Zinfandel Sonoma 2014 is a late harvest Zinfandel, made only in exceptional years: the grapes hang on the vine until they shrivel and concentrate their sugar, and fermentation stops with plenty of sweetness left, with no fortifying. It is sweet and dense, ripe dark cherry, plum, raisin and spice, with caramel from years in bottle. Its dark cherry echoes the tart black cherries and Luxardo sauce, so it is the half bottle for the Cherries Jubilee. Stand it upright, then pour gently in case of sediment, 2 to 3 ounces at 58 to 62°F in a small dessert glass. Ridge first made Essence in 1966.
